description: A Windows memory image's OS and capture time, live/scanned process views and tree, command lines, handles, services, network connections, suspicious executable regions, VADs, kernel modules and loaded DLLs (Volatility 3, offline symbols).
covers: What windows.info and the eleven listed Volatility plugins report with symbols already in the image. Linux and macOS images, unsupported hibernation/crash-dump variants, YARA rules and every other plugin are not covered; this recipe never fetches a symbol during case work.
